title: QUIC RFC 9000 Timer-Gated Path MTU Discovery Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home and recovery tests, timer-state regression tests, exact hosted HTTP/3 loopback validation, adjacent baseline/candidate performance controls, SpecTrace validation, Release build, full Release suite, and diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the bounded automatic runtime path from acknowledged application stream data through an idle PMTU timer, exact padded probe emission, matching acknowledgment or loss processing, and per-path ordinary datagram ceiling update.
expected_result: Ordinary traffic remains at 1200 bytes until one exact peer-capped PING-plus-PADDING probe is acknowledged; live application or recovery traffic is not displaced; loss leaves the ceiling unchanged; and matched HTTP/3 response workloads improve without stable control regressions.
procedure: Run the focused S14P3, recovery, timer, and metrics filters.
Run a hosted HTTP/3 smoke and diagnostic to prove the real deadline scheduler emits and acknowledges the probe.
Run adjacent baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline fixed and duplex 1 MiB c16 evidence with five samples per pass.
Run adjacent baseline/candidate/baseline controls across fixed, streaming, upload, and duplex; 1 KiB, 64 KiB, and 1 MiB; and c1, c4, and c16.
Repeat any control cell crossing the regression guardrail with longer adjacent samples.
Validate SpecTrace JSON, run the Release build and full Release test suite, and check the diff.
preconditions: The peer transport parameters and one-RTT packet protection material are committed.
The active path is validated and retains the safe 1200-byte initial ordinary ceiling.
Application stream data has been sent and acknowledged on the connection.
evidence: dotnet test tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-build -m:1 --filter focused PMTU and recovery filters

supplemental_sections.heading: Local Performance Gate
supplemental_sections.content: The final timer candidate's ten-sample c16 medians improved fixed 1 MiB throughput by 24.9% with p95 down 18.8% and allocation down 16.8%; duplex throughput improved 12.0% with p95 down 10.1%. The 36-cell control campaign had zero failures. Longer A/B/A repeats cleared the two short-run guardrail crossings: fixed 1 KiB c1 was +3.3% throughput with p95 +3.9%, and upload 1 MiB c16 was +4.6% throughput with p95 +1.3%. These are local loopback results, not public peer claims.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim repeated DPLPMTUD search, ICMP socket ingestion, alternative-path search, dedicated-host evidence, or public peer superiority.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-07-18: focused PMTU/recovery tests passed 44/44, broader timer/recovery/metrics tests passed 104/104, matched HTTP/3 performance and control workloads had zero validation failures, Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and the full Release test-project rerun passed 9,631/9,635 with 4 explicit skips and 0 failures. Two integration tests that failed once under the first full-suite load each passed 5/5 immediate isolated reruns before the clean full-suite rerun. SpecTrace core validation still reports the repository's pre-existing canonical parse/reference backlog; this new artifact validates once marked passed and does not add to that baseline. Git diff checking passed.
